questions.question: How much did I spend in total?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total), 2) FROM v_invoices
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total), 2) AS total_spent FROM v_invoices LIMIT 200

questions.question: How many invoices are in my ledger?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_invoices
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_invoices FROM v_invoices LIMIT 200

questions.question: What is the total GST I have paid?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_gst), 2) FROM v_invoices
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_gst), 2) AS total_gst_paid FROM v_invoices LIMIT 200

questions.question: How much IGST did I pay in total?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(igst), 2) FROM v_invoices
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(igst), 2) AS total_igst FROM v_invoices LIMIT 200

questions.question: How much CGST did I pay?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(cgst), 2) FROM v_invoices
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(cgst), 2) AS total_cgst FROM v_invoices LIMIT 200

questions.question: How much GST did I pay to each vendor?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT vendor_name, ROUND(SUM(total_gst), 2) FROM v_invoices GROUP BY vendor_name
questions.sql: SELECT vendor_name, ROUND(SUM(total_gst), 2) AS gst_paid FROM v_invoices GROUP BY vendor_name ORDER BY gst_paid DESC LIMIT 200

questions.question: Which vendor did I spend the most with?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT vendor_name FROM v_invoices GROUP BY vendor_name ORDER BY SUM(total) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.sql: SELECT vendor_name, ROUND(SUM(total), 2) AS total_spent FROM v_invoices GROUP BY vendor_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many invoices do I have from Sharma Auto Parts?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_invoices WHERE vendor_name ILIKE '%sharma auto parts%'
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM v_invoices WHERE vendor_name ILIKE '%sharma auto parts%' LIMIT 200

questions.question: How much did I spend with Lakshmi Traders?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total), 2) FROM v_invoices WHERE vendor_name ILIKE '%lakshmi traders%'
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total), 2) AS total_spent FROM v_invoices WHERE vendor_name ILIKE '%lakshmi traders%' LIMIT 200

questions.question: What is my average invoice amount?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(total), 2) FROM v_invoices
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(total) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS average_invoice_amount FROM v_invoices LIMIT 200

questions.question: What is the largest invoice total?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT MAX(total) FROM v_invoices
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(MAX(total), 2) AS max_invoice_total FROM v_invoices LIMIT 200

questions.question: What is the smallest invoice total?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT MIN(total) FROM v_invoices
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(MIN(total), 2) AS smallest_invoice_total FROM v_invoices LIMIT 200

questions.question: How much did I spend last quarter?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total), 2) FROM v_invoices WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total), 2) AS total_spent FROM v_invoices WHERE invoice_date >= CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 200

questions.question: How much GST did I pay last quarter?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_gst), 2) FROM v_invoices WHERE invoice_date >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND invoice_date < DATE '2026-10-01'
questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_gst), 2) AS total_gst_paid FROM v_invoices WHERE invoice_date >= CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND invoice_date < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 200

questions.question: How many invoices did I get each month?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', invoice_date)::date, COUNT(*) FROM v_invoices GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
questions.sql: SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', invoice_date) AS DATE) AS month, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM v_invoices GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200

questions.question: What was my total spending in each month?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', invoice_date)::date, ROUND(SUM(total), 2) FROM v_invoices GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
questions.sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(invoice_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, ROUND(SUM(total), 2) AS total_spending FROM v_invoices GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT description FROM v_line_items WHERE gst_rate = 18 ORDER BY description LIMIT 200

questions.question: How many line items have a 5% GST rate?

questions.question: What is the total taxable value of all my line items?

questions.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(taxable_value), 2) AS total_taxable_value FROM v_line_items LIMIT 200

questions.question: Which items did I buy from Gupta Electricals?

questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT description FROM v_line_items WHERE vendor_name ILIKE '%gupta electricals%' ORDER BY description LIMIT 200

questions.question: How many different vendors do I buy from?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT vendor_name) FROM v_invoices
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT vendor_name) AS vendor_count FROM v_invoices LIMIT 200

questions.question: List all my vendors.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT vendor_name FROM v_invoices
questions.sql: SELECT DISTINCT vendor_name FROM v_invoices ORDER BY vendor_name LIMIT 200

questions.question: How many invoices had IGST charged?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_invoices WHERE igst > 0
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM v_invoices WHERE igst IS NOT NULL AND igst > 0 LIMIT 200

questions.question: How many invoices had CGST and SGST charged?

questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM v_invoices WHERE cgst > 0 AND sgst > 0 LIMIT 200

questions.question: What is the total GST for each place of supply?

questions.sql: SELECT place_of_supply, ROUND(SUM(total_gst), 2) AS total_gst FROM v_invoices GROUP BY place_of_supply ORDER BY total_gst DESC LIMIT 200

questions.question: How much did I spend in August 2026?
